description: Search the web and return results. Uses Brave Search API if BRAVE_API_KEY is set, otherwise falls back to SearXNG and then DuckDuckGo. Supports domain filtering (site), freshness, and pagination (page).

freshness.description: Only return results from the last day/week/month/year (ignored by the DuckDuckGo fallback)

page.description: 1-based results page for pagination (default 1; ignored by the DuckDuckGo fallback)

site.description: Restrict results to a domain, e.g. "github.com"

timeoutMs.description: Overall retrieval deadline in milliseconds, including downloads (default 25000)

name: search
title: Web Search
